title: Homepage refresh and editor updates
summary: A refreshed Loops homepage lands alongside a set of editor updates, giving the site a cleaner look and the editor some helpful tweaks.
body_markdown:
### **Homepage refresh**


We put a new coat of polish on the homepage. A few new components, logos and feature highlights. It’s our summer refresh![Take a peek](https://loops.so/) .


But more importantly, we also just launched 👇


### **A better editor experience**


We’ve released some much-needed improvements to the editor.


The most notable improvement is the new` /` command, which allows you to quickly insert elements while composing an email. Now, you can stay in the flow while crafting your next message.


Additionally, you may notice improvements and bug fixes we’ve made to handling linking, changing the type of block in the editor and a dozen other quality of life changes


—


This is our final set of releases for the month!


If you missed it, here are links to[Week 1](https://loops.so/changelog/lists-and-preferences) ,[Week 2](https://loops.so/changelog/components) and[Week 3](https://loops.so/changelog/redesign) .


A new batch of updates drops at the end of August, back on our normal monthly release schedule :)
